acquisition method: The ten most intense peptide ions from the preview scan in the Orbitrap were fragmented
alkylation reagent: 50 mM iodoacetamide was added for 30 min and incubated in the dark for alkylation
collision energy: normalized collision energy 35% and resolution of 17,500
fractionation method: Each lane was divided into four gel slices.
instrument: coupled to an OrbiTrap QExactive mass spectrometer
labeling: We performed quantification based on protein intensities.
reduction concentration: 10 mM dithiothréitol at 98 °C for 1 h... treated with 1X Laemmli and 2 mM dithiothréitol
